title: Social loop
summary: A seamless 8 s loop for a feed: a living background, the brand and one line that comes and goes.

params.name: line
params.default: One line in the brand’s voice.
params.description: the line that comes and goes

params.name: what
params.description: name · what it is · where; empty builds it

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: text
params.description: how the line enters; empty follows motion.json

usage:
npx paper-motion add social-loop --name my-piece
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-piece/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-piece/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work: pamo add sage-night instrument) and, for the background, a shader-set entry (pamo add mesh-sage).
Structure and timing only; the look always comes from the brand.
Uses these moves from the engine: word-rise, pop-in, blur-in.
